author: /root/swahili_translation

terminology_decisions.decision: Nyenzo/nyenzo; this represents a surface finish or surface-material ID, not harvested raw goods. Changed twelve exact keys; retained numeric material IDs and 512×512/8-bit limits.
Retain Malighafi kuu / Mazao ya malighafi because TerrainStudio property primaryMaterial and resource yields refer to harvested game materials.
vifaa for physical equipment; nyenzo for authoring/reference resources. Do not globally replace all nyenzo with malighafi.

Heshima=prestige, Kiota/Viota=unit-producing Swarm building, malighafi=harvested materials, kitalu/vitalu=geographic blocks, Kuvumwani=moss. Only prestige appears in online entries needing change; no unrelated native edits.

Krediti for wallet balance/purchases; shukrani for attribution. Corrected Map credits and Terrain credits; kept attribution labels Credits & sources, Artwork and font credits, Custom content credits, Releases & credits, Development credits.
Specific admin restriction labels now say zuia kutuma ujumbe wa gumzo. Shared audio/admin Unmute remains neutral Ondoa kunyamazisha; standalone Mute used by audio player remains Nyamazisha.
PatternDialog density options use Msongamano mdogo/mkubwa; theme uses angavu/yenye giza. Neither density nor theme means physical weight.

Coordinated all three keys: singular Kipengele cha ukaguzi kinachohitaji kushughulikiwa; plural Vipengele vya ukaguzi vinavyohitaji kushughulikiwa; template {value1}: {value0}. Keeps both placeholders and grammatical composed count.

references.use: Clear contemporary wording, concise headings, noun agreement, stable technical format names; not a source certifying these specific game terms.
Read comparative evidence only; geology terms absent from online scope, no online substitution based on it.
Read comparative evidence only; clover term absent from online scope.

accepted_without_paraphrase: All 27 plural families preserve required one/other branches; invariant Swahili nouns legitimately share text.
Current/previous reporting-period actual source objects take priority over outdated key text.
Existing accepted English proper names, technical identifiers, licenses, URLs and symbol-only values remain unchanged.
Source whitespace not blanket modified; leading/trailing spaces retained where relevant and caller separators respected.
limits: No native catalog or Urdu catalog writes.
All 80 changes, including extra editorial fixes, require original reviewer recheck before resolution/finalization.
